annotations.title: Tirar dúvida sobre a consulta online

description: Returns Doutor Chamada's official answers (the same as the FAQ on the website) for one topic: how it works, medical certificates, prescriptions, exams, documents, payment and refunds, children and family, safety and data protection, and when not to use telemedicine. Use to answer questions about the service accurately. The only input is the topic.

tema.description: como-funciona = how it works, waiting time, video, hours, app; atestado = medical certificates (sick notes); receitas = prescriptions and renewals; exames = exam requests; documentos = receiving and fixing documents; pagamento = price, payment methods, refunds; familia = children and family; seguranca = trust, data protection, document validation; emergencias = when NOT to use telemedicine.
